title: WebGL - OffscreenCanvas getContext('webgl')
product-requirement: Terminals MUST permit obtaining WebGLRenderingContext via OffscreenCanvas getContext API
specification: Terminals MUST permit a visible BBC application (main thread) to obtain WebGLRenderingContext via OffscreenCanvas object's getContext API ('webgl' context identifier)
assertion: OffscreenCanvas.getContext('webgl') returns a valid WebGLRenderingContext on the main thread

changelog.summary: Initial creation of WebGL context test for OffscreenCanvas (main thread)
